spell.office.fire_bolt.desc: A fast bolt of flame that sets targets alight.
spell.office.fire_wall.desc: Raise a curtain of fire that burns whatever crosses it.
spell.office.flame_dash.desc: Burst forward on a trail of fire.
spell.office.fireball_barrage.desc: Rain fireballs on the spot you point at.
spell.office.meteor.desc: Call a burning rock from the sky — it leaves a crater.
spell.office.water_bullet.desc: A hard jet of water that knocks foes back.
spell.office.tidal_push.desc: A wave that shoves everything in front of you.
spell.office.bubble_shield.desc: A bubble that stops arrows and softens blows.
spell.office.water_prison.desc: Trap a foe in a sphere of water.
spell.office.water_dragon.desc: A dragon of water that crashes down and floods the land.
spell.office.gust.desc: A blast of wind that throws foes back.
spell.office.blade_wind.desc: Crescent blades that cut foes and foliage.
spell.office.air_step.desc: Leap off the air itself — even mid-jump.
spell.office.tornado.desc: A whirlwind that wanders forward, lifting everything.
spell.office.wind_sphere.desc: A spinning sphere that drills through anything you hit.
spell.office.spark.desc: A quick zap that arcs to a second foe.
spell.office.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning that leaps from foe to foe.
spell.office.chidori_strike.desc: Charge through your target, carving a scorched trench.
spell.office.earth_wall.desc: Raise a wall of earth for half a minute.
spell.office.earth_spikes.desc: Spikes burst from the ground in a line.
spell.office.quake.desc: A shockwave that ripples out through the ground.
spell.office.mountain_fist.desc: A giant fist of rock erupts and leaves a mountain spire.
spell.office.shadow_bolt.desc: A bolt of shadow that saps strength.
spell.office.gravity_well.desc: A dark point that drags everything in.
spell.office.shadow_step.desc: Step out of the shadows behind your target.
spell.office.shadow_bind.desc: Shadows root a foe in place.
spell.office.black_hole.desc: A black hole that devours the land around it.
spell.office.recall.desc: Shift + cast to mark home. Cast to return there.
magic.office.choose_hint: Hover a sigil to read its page. Click it to bind.
magic.office.bind_note: This is permanent (a Rebinding Seal can change it).
magic.office.bind_failed: The binding did not take. Try again.
magic.office.hint: Off hand + empty hand: tap right-click to cast · hold to charge · R wheel · Shift+scroll
magic.office.signs_hint: Arrow keys or WASD · Esc gives up
magic.office.fizzle: The signs broke — the spell fizzled
magic.office.no_home: No home yet — Shift + cast Recall to mark one
magic.office.home_blocked: Your home is blocked or unsafe — you stay where you are
magic.office.busy: Too much magic here — wait a moment
magic.office.wrong_element: %s belongs to another element — you are bound to %s
magic.office.undo_done: Restored %d blocks from %d casts; %d left alone (changed since, or thrown as debris)
magic.office.undo_help: Undo a player's last n terrain casts (the newest 20 are kept). Blocks changed since the cast are left alone
magic.office.travel_cooldown: Travel shares Recall's cooldown — ready in %s s
magic.office.travel_pending: You already asked %s — wait for an answer
magic.office.travel_too_soon: Give %s a moment — you can ask again in %s s
magic.office.travel_friend_full: %s has too many requests waiting — try again soon
magic.office.travel_accept_hover: %s appears beside you after a 3 s channel
magic.office.travel_deny_hover: Say no — they stay where they are
magic.office.travel_gone: That travel request is no longer open
magic.office.travel_blocked: No safe spot beside %s — you stay where you are
magic.office.travel_now_on: Friends can ask to travel to you again (/magic travel off to refuse)
magic.office.travel_now_off: You refuse travel requests now (/magic travel on to allow them)
magic.office.travel_state_on: You accept travel requests (/magic travel off to refuse)
magic.office.travel_state_off: You refuse travel requests (/magic travel on to allow them)
magic.office.friends_none: Nobody else is online right now
magic.office.travel_blurb: Once they accept, you appear beside them.
magic.office.friends_hint: Click a friend to ask · they accept, 3 s later you're there · shares Recall's cooldown
